correctness.rationale: The exact three-disk model is reconstructed from its circle-intersection vertex relation and minimum-width identity. Erosion distributes over intersections, yielding exact eroded vertex and circular-segment formulas. Continuous strict area decrease gives the unique Cheeger root; the established convex Cheeger characterization identifies the six alternating arcs. The large-R expansion is algebraic and analytic, with nonzero implicit derivative, and produces the stated sharp coefficient; independent numerical ray integration and optional SymPy check critical identities in verify.py. All claims are scoped to planar regular disk triangles.
